$comment: Stage 6 demo-world manifest. Synthetic. This file is a COMPACT, auditable description of deterministic background history that predates the authored 2025-2026 archive. `src/steward/seed/world.py` expands each row into a full CaseRecord-compatible object with stable ids, verified source references, and safe synthetic email addresses. Nothing here is an elevator case, by design: the authored elevator scorecards are the demo's central argument and must not move. Every background case runs January 2023 to December 2024, so the loaded archive spans at least 24 months. Amounts are strings so they load as Decimal without touching a float. `thread` true means world.py also synthesizes a short vendor email thread for that case so the console has correspondence to show; enough are flagged that the loaded bundle carries at least fifteen threads in total.

id_scheme.note: Case ids are hist-bg-YYYY-NN, quote ids are q-<case>-<vendor-slug>, message ids are <case>-<vendor-slug>-<seq>@vendors.<domain>. All derived deterministically from the row, never random, so loading twice yields identical output.
